text:
Ethan Support: heads-up - customer 'Lighthouse Labs' (acct LL-614) onboarding stalled; activation emails bounced after SAML upload. Ticket: https://redwood.zd/ticket/70123
Priya CS: noted. Renewal window? who is the CSM? @Diego
Diego CS: I'm the CSM. Renewal in ~49 days. What error are you seeing?
Ethan Support: log snippet:
```
SAML Error: Recipient attribute mismatch
SP metadata: https://sso.lighthouselabs.com/metadata.xml
```
Ethan Support: reprovisioning didn't resolve it. IdP team mentioned a cert rotation earlier today.
Priya CS: quick plan: 1) warm transfer to CS in next 30m, 2) send customer-facing status plus a short ops note to their IdP admin, 3) schedule enablement for tomorrow AM PST. Diego, can you own the handoff?
Diego CS: I will own it. Target metric = pilot seats live by EOD tomorrow. I'll create a shared invite and cc their IdP admin.
Sam Solutions: drafting a compact fallback runbook:
- temporarily allow recipient override in staging
- run `redwood saml rbind --tenant LL-614 --force`
- verify with `curl -I https://app.lighthouselabs.com/_status`
I'll post the draft in #eng-platform for a quick review.
Ava AE: looping AE thread to prep renewal outreach if onboarding slips past 24h. I have the exec sponsor contact.
Priya CS: Ethan please send the customer-safe ping now: "We're investigating an SSO provisioning mismatch and working on a temporary workaround; will follow up with a scheduled call." :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ethan Support: sent at 4140001260. Customer replied: "Thanks, we'll join a morning call and will include our IdP admin." :thumbsup: 
Diego CS: recap of owners: Diego -> warm transfer + invite; Sam -> publish fallback doc; Priya -> create renewal-watch (7-day cadence); Ava -> prep AE outreach. I'll mark account health: at-risk (onboarding) and flag renewal.
OpsBot: Task created: LL-614-warm-transfer assigned to Diego, due 4140001860.
Priya CS: capturing feedback: onboarding docs should include cert-rotation checklist and recipient/NameID examples. I'll file this to the product feedback board and post a follow-up summary after the enablement call. :white_check_mark:
